newsitem.title: UK: UK shares rise, shrugging off rate concerns.
newsitem.headline: UK shares rise, shrugging off rate concerns.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index opened higher on Wednesday as investors shrugged off worries over the implications for further interest rate rises from the budget's tax measures yesterday.
But business was light, traders said and much of the rise in London's blue-chip index was technical.

"There's no business around and the futures have just squeezed up and gone rampant," one trader said. "People are just ignoring the implications of the budget, and saying they are just marginal ones."
